walkthroughs.body_html:
Tawhid = the oneness of Allah.

Surah 112: 'Say, He is Allah, the One. Allah is eternal. He neither begets nor is begotten.'

Shirk (associating partners with Allah) is the gravest sin. Allah has no image, no equal, no rival.

Sunni Muslims hold six articles of faith:

1. Tawhid — oneness of Allah
2. Malaikah — angels
3. Holy books — Qur'an, Torah, Injil, Psalms, Scrolls of Abraham
4. Risalah — prophets (Adam to Muhammad)
5. Akhirah — Day of Judgement
6. Qadr — predestination

Shi'a Muslims hold Five Roots (Usul al-Din):

1. Tawhid — oneness
2. Adl — divine justice
3. Nubuwwah — prophethood
4. Imamah — leadership of the Imams (from Ali)
5. Mi'ad — Day of Judgement

Adl (justice) and Imamah are the distinctively Shi'a beliefs.
